info.name: Maintain Ops Suite
info.summary: Configuration, Preventive Maintenance, and Deficiency Tracking
info.description:
Ops Suite is an integrated operations management platform with three modules:
1. Configuration Tracker — Hardware, software, and firmware digital twin. Assets are fully cross-linked so you always know what software and firmware runs on which hardware and where it lives.
2. Preventive Maintenance — Schedule and track PM procedures linked to configuration assets. Track periodicity, last completed, next due date, assigned technician, and linked SOP documents. Automatically calculates next-due dates and flags overdue items.
3. Deficiency Tracking — Log and manage deficiencies found during PM inspections or discovered on walkdowns. Tracks severity (SEV-1 through SEV-5), troubleshooting history, cost estimates (parts/labor/contractor), man-days, outside entity requirements, and assignment to Nextcloud users.
